summary: Keep bare governed invocation from creating configuration before no-change validation

delivery.outcome: Bare goal -a on a governed repository reads configuration without creating or rewriting goal.yaml before governance and no-change validation. Publish via protected Validator.
nonGoals: No changes to ungoverned configuration bootstrap or approval rules

architecture.decision: Load configuration without persisting it for all-flags governed invocation. Existing delivery and governance gates remain authoritative.
architecture.rollback: Revert the CLI bootstrap guard and its regression tests together.

validation.evidence: Focused regression tests and actual invocation in wellmanifest/performance
